tasks.prompt: In PostgreSQL, what does SELECT round(2.5::double precision) return? Answer with the number only.
In PostgreSQL, what does SELECT 7 / 2 return? Answer with the value only.
Does PostgreSQL accept SELECT '2026-02-30'::date without an error? Answer yes or no.
Does SQLite 3.49 accept a RIGHT JOIN? Answer yes or no.
In PostgreSQL, what does SELECT 'a' || NULL return? Answer with the value, or NULL.
In PostgreSQL, is TIMESTAMP '2026-09-30 15:00' BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' true? Answer yes or no.
An SQLite table has a TEXT column n holding '10', '9' and '100'. Which value comes first with ORDER BY n? Answer with the value only.
In PostgreSQL, how many rows does this return? SELECT x FROM (VALUES (1), (2)) v(x) WHERE x NOT IN (SELECT y FROM (VALUES (2), (NULL)) n(y)). Answer with the number only.
Can CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY run inside a transaction block in PostgreSQL? Answer yes or no.
